newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Philip Morris wins bidding for Tabaqueira.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris wins bidding for Tabaqueira.

text.p: A consortium headed by Philip Morris Cos. Inc. won the bidding for a 65 percent stake in Portuguese tobacco concern Tabaqueira, the Portuguese government announced Thursday.

Philip Morris, the maker of Marlboro and Virginia Slims brands, beat off competition from a group led by Spain's Tabacalera and the French company Sieta (Ste Nationale d'Exploitation Industrielle des Tabacs et Allumettes).
Philip Morris is allied with the Portuguese Jorge de Mello group.

It offered 33.15 billion escudos ($211 million) for the 65 percent stake, slightly below the 36.47 billion ($232 million) offered by the Spanish-led consortium where Tabacalera joined with Portuguese tobacco firm Empresa Madeirense de Tabacos.
The government had said all along that price would not be the only consideration and that it would also be looking at the candidates' plans for the development of the sector.
